common_cancel: A button that closes a dialog and changes nothing.
common_change: Hint beside the confirm button on a switch: flips it.
common_play: Hint or button that starts a stream with the picked profile.
common_select: Hint beside the confirm button: picks the focused row.
common_remove: Button verb confirming a removal in a dialog.
common_size_gb: A size in gigabytes (decimal, as stores count). {size}: the number, formatted for the language, e.g. 12.3.
common_size_mb: A size in megabytes (decimal). {size}: the number, formatted for the language, e.g. 48.
common_size_kb: A size in kilobytes (decimal). {size}: the number, formatted for the language, e.g. 512.
common_add: Button: add the new item being edited (here a new shortcut).
common_edit: Button or hint-bar verb: open the item for editing.
common_reset: Button or hint-bar verb: back to the default.
common_choose: Hint-bar verb: pick the highlighted entry.
common_percent: A percentage. {value} is a whole number, formatted by the client.
common_hz: A refresh rate. {value} is a whole number of hertz.
common_mbits: A bitrate in megabits per second. {value}: the number, already formatted ("20", "12.5").
common_gbits: A bitrate in gigabits per second. {value}: the number, already formatted ("1", "1.5").
common_unit_mbits: The unit alone, shown in an empty bitrate field before any digit is typed.
common_disconnect: Button verb: ends the stream and leaves the host.
common_dismiss: Button verb: closes a notice for now.
common_next: Button verb: goes to the next step.
common_retry: Button that tries a failed action again.
